# Xenon Client v1.3.0

## What's New

### Color Wheel Picker
- Full hue/saturation color wheel with brightness slider for picking colors in module configs
- Click any color swatch in a module's config screen to open the interactive color wheel
- Drag around the wheel to pick hue and saturation, use the brightness bar on the right
- Live hex color preview updates as you drag
- Supported on Block ESP (ESP color) and Player ESP (default, sneaking, friend colors)

### Tracer Toggle on ESP Modules
- **Block ESP** — Tracer toggle (default: OFF)
- **Storage ESP** — Tracer toggle (default: OFF)
- **Player ESP** — Tracer toggle (default: OFF)
- Tracer appears as the first setting in each ESP module's config screen

### Previous Releases Included
- Circular wheel GUI with section navigation (v1.0.0)
- 5 modules with proper mixins: Sprint, Fullbright, Block ESP, Storage ESP, Player ESP (v1.1.0)
- ESP performance optimization with cached incremental scanning (v1.2.0)

**Note:** Tracer line rendering and color persistence across sessions will be added in follow-up updates.

releases.notes:
## Performance Optimization Release

Eliminates lag when using ESP modules at high range values.

### Changes
- **Block ESP**: Cached incremental scanning replaces per-frame O(n³) brute-force. Scan spread across 5 frames, cached results rendered every frame. Only rescans on player movement or config change.
- **Block lookups**: HashSet O(1) instead of List.contains() O(n)
- **All ESP**: Pre-allocated static Vector3f normals, pre-computed rangeSq, simplified color handling

### Download
Drop `xenon-client-1.2.0.jar` into your `.minecraft/mods` folder (requires Fabric Loader 0.18.6+ and Fabric API on MC 26.1.1).

releases.notes:
## Xenon Client v1.1.0

### Modules
- **Sprint** - Auto-sprint via SprintMixin (fully legit)
- **Fullbright** - Full brightness via FullbrightMixin
- **Block ESP** - Highlight tracked blocks through walls, searchable block picker with icons
- **Storage ESP** - Highlight chests, ender chests, shulkers, barrels, etc. with per-type colors
- **Player ESP** - Highlight players with configurable colors

### Fixes in this release
- ESP outlines now render **through walls** (custom no-depth RenderPipeline)
- Fixed Player ESP crash (missing setLineWidth in vertex format)
- Block picker shows **block item icons** instead of text names
- Includes wheel rendering performance fix from v1.0.1

### Usage
Drop `xenon-client-1.1.0.jar` in your mods folder with Fabric Loader 0.18.6+ and Fabric API on MC 26.1.1. Press **Right Shift** to open the wheel.

## Xenon Client v1.0.1

Performance fix for extreme lag when opening the wheel GUI.

### Changes
- Rewrote wheel rendering: ~800 fill calls/frame instead of ~50,000
- Single filled ring background instead of per-section arc scanlines
- Highlight arc drawn only for the hovered section (1 instead of 6)
- Reduced glow rings from 4 nested circles to 1
- Halved circle outline resolution (64 steps vs 128)

### Requirements
- Minecraft 26.1.1
- Fabric Loader 0.18.6+
- Fabric API 0.145.3+26.1.1
- Java 25+

### Installation
1. Download `xenon-client-1.0.1.jar` below
2. Replace the old jar in your `.minecraft/mods` folder
3. Launch Minecraft with Fabric Loader
4. Press Right Shift in-game to open the wheel
